description: Proposed schema for the Project Management MVP. One JSON board document per user. See docs/DATABASE.md for the reasoning.

users.description: One row per account. The MVP creates a single row for the hardcoded account.

username.description: Login name. Unique, so it can identify the account.

password_hash.description: Unused in the MVP, which authenticates against AUTH_USERNAME and AUTH_PASSWORD. Nullable rather than filled with a placeholder, so nothing reads a fake hash. Populated when real accounts arrive.

boards.description: One row per board. user_id is UNIQUE, which enforces the MVP rule of one board per user.

user_id.description: Owner. UNIQUE for now; drop the constraint to allow several boards per user.

data.description: The board as a JSON document, matching boardDocument below.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC, rewritten on every save.

ddl: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, username TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, password_hash TEXT, created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS boards (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, user_id INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, data TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(data)), updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')));

boardDocument.title: BoardData
boardDocument.description: Mirrors BoardData in frontend/src/lib/kanban.ts. Columns hold ordered card ids; cards live in a lookup keyed by id.

invariants: Every id in a column's cardIds exists as a key in cards.
Every key in cards appears in exactly one column's cardIds: no orphans, no duplicates.
Column ids are unique within the board.
invariantsNote: JSON Schema cannot express these cross references. They are enforced in the backend on every write, whether it comes from PUT /api/board or from the AI in Part 9.
